target: unchanged same-person same-visit tft_tug seconds; exact timed trial unresolved
population: same selected TUG and walking files of previous238; no trial substitution
phase_detection: local positive/negative smoothed pelvis-height velocity peaks near chair; net change>=0.08m; 0.25s margins; sitting endpoint within0.12m of initial height; no manual labels
fixed: 2 seconds around peak, boundary shift only if source supports full2s; actual full transition duration not a model input
event: local transition core plus0.25s margins; includes duration features
quality: native vertical speed<=3m/s in selected chair clips; previous horizontal<=6m/s in turn and added context; flagged sensitivity retains vertical failures; no imputed missing phases
observation: same original walking3s and complete turn D; augmented adds rise/sit clips, control adds exactly same total seconds of non-chair TUG walking around original turn; windows disjoint; no padding or elapsed wholeTUG
feature_note: TurnContext retains original13features and per-side vertical summaries excluding explicit duration, plus horizontal context summaries; ChairMotion omits explicit phase durations; other motion summaries can still encode timing
training: reuse same frozen outer and inner person folds restricted to each common cohort; RF128 leaf2/5 innerMAE; 5partitions x3seeds; localCPU
metrics: MAE, bias, positive underprediction; paired person bootstrap conditional on fits; 20s descriptive threshold
